get.description: Aggregates this workspace's tool calls into a series of buckets and a top list. The window is at most 90 days; a wider or reversed one is refused with 422. by=server also needs servers:read. A workspace may have two of these queries running per replica; a third is refused with 429. Answers are reused for 60 seconds.
